title: Tuono 660 Factory
description: Representing Aprilia's prowess in the Urban Roadster class, the Aprilia Tuono 660 Factory is delivers muscular mid-range acceleration paired with effortless city maneuvering. A 660cc powerplant pumps out 85 HP and 70 Nm of torque, striking an optimal balance between fuel economy and spirited passing power. With a balanced 790mm seat height providing confident footing and natural knee comfort and a comfortable Upright Neutral layout, it offers fatigue-free ergonomics whether carving traffic or cruising the open highway.
